# TASK-150 — `pnpm nim:check`

- **Status:** In progress — implemented, verification incomplete
- **Area:** NVIDIA NIM provider (2026-10-01)

## Intent

`pnpm nim:check` mirrors `pnpm ollama:check`: lists models, streams one reply and checks one tool call against the real endpoint. It needs a key, so it is the only live verification path and is reported as not run unless someone runs it.

## What it delivers

Script written and exercised against a fake server (no key, bad address, success, no tool support). Stays open until someone runs it with a real key.
